title: Yellowed Crusty French Pork Cassoulet
description: A tangy and tender French dish from Provence, featuring pork and white beans in a rich bouillon, perfect for a midnight craving. This sugar-free-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in the kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add the pork cubes and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, thyme, and bay leaves, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soaked white beans, bouillon cubes, and 4 cups of water to the cauldron.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the cauldron and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the pork is tender and the beans are cooked.
Remove the cauldron from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Deglaze the fond by scraping the bottom of the cauldron with a wooden spoon.
Serve the cassoulet hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
